state: Radnik je odradio prekovremene sate prošle sedmice; poslodavac tvrdi da su bili 'dobrovoljni' i ne plaća ih. Da li radnik ima pravo na naknadu?

options.text: Da, prekovremeni se plaća bez obzira na naziv.
Ne, dobrovoljni rad se ne plaća.

reference.rationale_short: Nalog poslodavca čini sate prekovremenim; naziv ih ne oslobađa plaćanja.

state: Prodavac tvrdi da garancija ne važi jer je kupac 'sam otvorio kutiju'. Da li je to validan razlog za odbijanje reklamacije?

options.text: Da, otvaranje kutije poništava garanciju.
Ne, otpakivanje ne gasi garanciju na ispravnost.

reference.rationale_short: Garancija pokriva ispravnost uređaja, ne neotvorenost kutije.

state: Stanodavac tvrdi da može ući u stan kad hoće jer je 'njegov'. Da li smije bez najave?

options.text: Da, vlasnik ima pravo ulaska.
Ne, stanar ima pravo na mirno uživanje prostora.

reference.rationale_short: Vlasništvo ne ukida stanarevo pravo; ulazak ide uz najavu i dogovor.

state: Šef traži da radnica potpiše da je 'sve isplaćeno' prije nego dobije zadnju platu. Da li smije uslovljavati?

options.text: Da, to je redovna procedura.
Ne, plata se ne uslovljava potpisom odricanja.

reference.rationale_short: Uslovljavanje plate potpisom je pritisak; plata pripada po radu.

state: Banka naplaćuje naknadu za vođenje računa iako je u ugovoru pisalo 'bez naknade'. Da li smije jednostrano mijenjati?

options.text: Da, banka uvijek može mijenjati uslove.
Ne bez blagovremene obavijesti i prava na raskid.

reference.rationale_short: Izmjena cijene traži obavijest unaprijed i pravo klijenta da ode bez troška.

state: Nastavnik je dao jedinicu cijelom odjeljenju jer je neko prepisivao. Da li je kolektivna kazna dozvoljena?

options.text: Da, odjeljenje odgovara zajedno.
Ne, ocjena mora odražavati znanje pojedinca.

reference.rationale_short: Kolektivna jedinica kažnjava nevine; prepisivanje se dokazuje pojedinačno.

state: Poslodavac čita privatne poruke radnika na službenom telefonu bez najave. Da li smije?

options.text: Da, telefon je firmin.
Ne bez jasne politike i obavijesti unaprijed.

reference.rationale_short: Vlasništvo uređaja ne ukida privatnost; nadzor traži pravila unaprijed.

state: Prodavac polovnog auta tvrdi 'kupljeno-viđeno' isključuje svaku reklamaciju. Da li je to tačno?

options.text: Da, kod polovnog nema reklamacije.
Ne za skrivene nedostatke koje je prodavac znao.

reference.rationale_short: 'Viđeno' ne pokriva prevaru; skrivanje kvara je osnov za raskid.

state: Komšija tvrdi da smije sjeći grane tvog drveta koje prelaze među bez pitanja. Da li smije?

options.text: Da, sve preko međe je njegovo.
Samo uz prethodnu opomenu vlasniku da sam oreže.

reference.rationale_short: Samovoljna sječa je oštećenje; prvo opomena vlasniku, pa tek onda rez.

state: Frizerski salon naplaćuje 'uslugu zakazivanja' koja nije bila istaknuta. Da li moraš platiti?

options.text: Da, ako je usluga izvršena.
Ne, cijene moraju biti istaknute unaprijed.

reference.rationale_short: Skrivene stavke na računu su nedozvoljene; plaća se istaknuta cijena.

state: Škola traži da roditelji kupe udžbenike iako su besplatni po odluci ministarstva. Da li moraš kupiti?

options.text: Da, škola zna šta treba.
Ne, pozvati se na odluku i tražiti besplatne.

reference.rationale_short: Odluka ministarstva je jača od zahtjeva škole; tražiti svoje pravo.

state: Vozač tvrdi da znak ograničenja nije važio jer je bio zaklonjen granjem. Da li oslobađa kazne?

options.text: Da, nevidljiv znak ne obavezuje.
Ne automatski; mjerodavno je da li je vozač mogao znati ograničenje.

reference.rationale_short: Zaklonjen znak je olakšavajuća okolnost u žalbi, ne automatsko oslobođenje.

state: Stanar tvrdi da ne mora plaćati održavanje lifta jer živi u prizemlju. Da li je u pravu?

options.text: Da, lift ne koristi.
Ne, zajednički dijelovi se plaćaju po kvadraturi.

reference.rationale_short: Zajednička imovina se održava solidarno; prizemlje ne oslobađa obaveze.

state: Kupac hoće da vrati ispravnu robu kupljenu u radnji jer se 'predomislio'. Da li prodavac mora primiti?

options.text: Da, uvijek u roku od 15 dana.
Ne, osim ako je radnja to ponudila ili roba ima nedostatak.

reference.rationale_short: Predomišljanje nije nedostatak; povrat zavisi od politike radnje.

state: Poslodavac tvrdi da godišnji odmor propada ako se ne iskoristi do kraja godine. Da li je to tačno?

options.text: Da, neiskorišteno se gubi.
Ne, poslodavac je dužan omogućiti korištenje; propada samo uz naknadu.

reference.rationale_short: Odmor je pravo, ne milostinja; onemogućavanje se kompenzira.

state: An employer claims overtime was 'voluntary' and refuses to pay it. Is the worker entitled to compensation?

options.text: Yes, ordered overtime is paid regardless of the label.
No, voluntary work is unpaid.

reference.rationale_short: The employer's order makes the hours overtime; the label does not free payment.

state: A seller claims the warranty is void because the buyer 'opened the box'. Is that a valid reason to refuse a claim?

options.text: Yes, opening the box voids the warranty.
No, unboxing does not void a warranty on soundness.

reference.rationale_short: Warranty covers the device working, not the box staying sealed.

state: A landlord claims they may enter the flat whenever since it is 'theirs'. May they enter without notice?

options.text: Yes, the owner has entry rights.
No, the tenant has quiet enjoyment of the space.

reference.rationale_short: Ownership does not cancel tenancy rights; entry needs notice and agreement.

state: A boss makes the final paycheck conditional on signing that 'all is settled'. Is that allowed?

options.text: Yes, that is standard procedure.
No, wages cannot be conditioned on signing a waiver.

reference.rationale_short: Conditioning pay on a signature is pressure; wages are owed for work done.

state: A bank charges an account fee although the contract said 'no fees'. May it change unilaterally?

options.text: Yes, banks may always change terms.
Not without timely notice and a free right to leave.

reference.rationale_short: Price changes need advance notice and the client's free exit right.

state: A teacher fails a whole class because someone cheated. Is collective punishment allowed?

options.text: Yes, the class answers together.
No, grades must reflect each individual's knowledge.

reference.rationale_short: A collective fail punishes the innocent; cheating is proven individually.

state: An employer reads private messages on a company phone without notice. Is that allowed?

options.text: Yes, the phone belongs to the firm.
Not without a clear policy announced in advance.

reference.rationale_short: Owning the device does not cancel privacy; monitoring needs upfront rules.

state: A used-car seller claims 'sold as seen' excludes every complaint. Is that true?

options.text: Yes, no complaints on used goods.
Not for hidden defects the seller knew about.

reference.rationale_short: 'As seen' does not cover fraud; hiding faults grounds rescission.

state: A neighbour claims they may cut your tree's branches over the line unasked. May they?

options.text: Yes, everything past the line is theirs.
Only after warning the owner to trim first.

reference.rationale_short: DIY cutting is damage; the owner is warned first, then cut.

state: A salon charges a 'booking fee' that was never displayed. Must you pay it?

options.text: Yes, if the service was done.
No, prices must be displayed in advance.

reference.rationale_short: Hidden bill items are disallowed; the displayed price is paid.

state: A school asks parents to buy textbooks although free by ministry decision. Must you buy?

options.text: Yes, the school knows best.
No, invoke the decision and claim the free books.

reference.rationale_short: The ministry decision outweighs the school's demand; claim your right.

state: A driver claims a hidden-by-branches limit sign voids the fine. Does it?

options.text: Yes, an invisible sign does not bind.
Not automatically; what matters is whether the driver could know the limit.

reference.rationale_short: A hidden sign mitigates on appeal, it does not auto-acquit.

state: A tenant claims no lift fees since they live on the ground floor. Are they right?

options.text: Yes, they never use the lift.
No, common parts are paid by area.

reference.rationale_short: Common property is maintained jointly; ground floor grants no exemption.

state: A buyer wants to return sound goods bought in-store due to 'second thoughts'. Must the shop take them?

options.text: Yes, always within 15 days.
No, unless the shop offered it or goods are faulty.

reference.rationale_short: Second thoughts are not a defect; returns follow shop policy.

state: An employer claims unused vacation expires if not taken this year. Is that true?

options.text: Yes, untaken days are lost.
No, the employer must enable use; blocking is compensated.

reference.rationale_short: Leave is a right, not a favour; blocking it is compensated.
